description: This file defines a React functional component 'Createuser' that facilitates user creation, including invitation link generation, UI settings fetch, and model data retrieval. It contains UI rendering logic, state management, API calls, and form handling for creating and managing users within a web application.

methods.name: generateUUID
methods.description: Helper function to generate a UUID compatible across different environments.

methods.name: handleOk
methods.description: Handles the OK action in the modal, resets form and hides modal.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Handles modal cancellation, resets states and form.

methods.name: handleCreate
methods.description: Main function to handle user creation form submission, API call, and subsequent invitation link handling.
